title: Executive Functionning Study for Assessing the Effect of Neurofeedback
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 24 participants performing three executive functioning tasks (N-Back, Sustained Attention to Response Task, and Local Global) across two sessions as part of a neurofeedback intervention study. The dataset includes preprocessed EEG data with standardized referencing and downsampling, along with source data files, providing a resource for investigating cognitive control and attention mechanisms.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during three cognitive tasks: N-Back (working memory, 1-3 back conditions), Sustained Attention to Response Task (inhibitory control), and Local Global (selective attention). Two sessions were conducted on the first and last days of the neurofeedback experiment. Data processing included average referencing, downsampling from 2048 to 256 Hz, and high-pass filtering at 1 Hz using an elliptical non-linear filter in MATLAB and EEGLAB.
